I've finally cut the knot in my mind; I will make a site (community perhaps) to promote women in heavy music (post-hardcore, metalcore, deathcore).

I've been struggling with whether I'm 'allowed' to do so as a man, and the fact that I know there's the sentiment that as band you don't necessarily want to be known as 'female-fronted', you're just whatever genre you play.

But I genuinely get happy from screaming women 🤭 and maybe it's not all that deep. Anyway, currently #listening: Palebloom - Maybe I'm Not That Alright

If you want a preview, I did a toot-series once; see this thread https://todon.nl/@gerben/109500551703460567
